G1.def: the first letter of the alphabet; figuratively, only (from its use as a numeral) the first:

G4.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G922 (βάρος);

G7.def: Abijah, the name of two Israelites

G12.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a variation of G1037 (βυθός);

G15.def: to be a well-doer (as a favor or a duty)

G21.def: properly, to jump for joy, i.e. exult
G21.kjv: be (exceeding) glad, with exceeding joy, rejoice (greatly)

G22.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1062 (γάμος);

G23.def: akin to the base of G43 (ἀγκάλη)); to be greatly afflicted, i.e. (figuratively) indignant
G23.kjv: be much (sore) displeased, have (be moved with, with) indignation

G25.def: to love (in a social or moral sense)

G26.def: love, i.e. affection or benevolence; specially (plural) a love-feast

G29.def: properly, to be a courier, i.e. (by implication) to press into public service

G30.def: compare the base of G43 (ἀγκάλη)); a receptacle

G32.def: compare G34 (ἀγέλη)) (to bring tidings); a messenger; especially an "angel"; by implication, a pastor

G35.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G1075 (γενεαλογέω);

G36.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G1085 (γένος);
G36.def: properly, without kin, i.e. (of unknown descent, and by implication) ignoble

G37.def: to make holy, i.e. (ceremonially) purify or consecrate; (mentally) to venerate

G38.def: properly, purification, i.e. (the state) purity; concretely (by Hebraism) a purifier

G40.def: sacred (physically, pure, morally blameless or religious, ceremonially, consecrated)

G46.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and the same as G1102 (γναφεύς);

G48.def: to make clean, i.e. (figuratively) sanctify (ceremonially or morally)

G50.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3539 (νοιέω);
G50.def: not to know (through lack of information or intelligence); by implication, to ignore (through disinclination)
G50.kjv: (be) ignorant(-ly), not know, not understand, unknown

G53.def: properly, clean, i.e. (figuratively) innocent, modest, perfect

G56.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G1108 (γνῶσις);

G57.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G1110 (γνωστός);

G58.def: probably akin to G1453 (ἐγείρω)); properly, the town-square (as a place of public resort); by implication, a market or thoroughfare

G59.def: properly, to go to market, i.e. (by implication) to purchase; specially, to redeem

G60.def: relating to the market-place, i.e. forensic (times); by implication, vulgar

G61.def: (abstractly) a catching (of fish); also (concretely) a haul (of fish)

G62.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G1121 (γράμμα);

G63.derivation: from G68 (ἀγρός) and G832 (αὐλέω) (in the sense of G833 (αὐλή));

G66.def: wild (as pertaining to the country), literally (natural) or figuratively (fierce)

G67.def: wild-horse tamer; Agrippas, one of the Herods

G68.def: a field (as a drive for cattle); genitive case, the country; specially, a farm, i.e. hamlet
G68.kjv: country, farm, piece of ground, land

G69.derivation: ultimately from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G5258 (ὕπνος);
G69.def: to be sleepless, i.e. keep awake

G71.def: properly, to lead; by implication, to bring, drive, (reflexively) go, (specially) pass (time), or (figuratively) induce
G71.kjv: be, bring (forth), carry, (let) go, keep, lead away, be open

G72.def: a bringing up, i.e. mode of living

G73.def: properly, a place of assembly (as if led), i.e. (by implication) a contest (held there); figuratively, an effort or anxiety

G74.def: a struggle (properly, the state), i.e. (figuratively) anguish

G75.def: to struggle, literally (to compete for a prize), figuratively (to contend with an adversary), or genitive case (to endeavor to accomplish something)

G76.def: Adam, the first man; typically (of Jesus) man (as his representative)

G80.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a connective particle) and (the womb);
G80.def: a brother (literally or figuratively) near or remote (much like G1 (Α))

G81.def: brotherhood (properly, the feeling of brotherliness), i.e. the (Christian) fraternity

G82.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1212 (δῆλος);

G85.derivation: from a derivative of (to be sated to loathing);
G85.kjv: be full of heaviness, be very heavy

G86.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G1492 (εἴδω);
G86.def: properly, unseen, i.e. "Hades" or the place (state) of departed souls

G87.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1252 (διακρίνω);

G88.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of G1223 (διά) and G3007 (λείπω);

G89.def: uninterruptedly, i.e. without omission (on an appropriate occasion)

G90.derivation: from a derivative of a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1311 (διαφθείρω);

G91.def: to be unjust, i.e. (actively) do wrong (morally, socially or physically)
G91.kjv: hurt, injure, be an offender, be unjust, (do, suffer, take) wrong

G92.kjv: evil doing, iniquity, matter of wrong

G93.def: (legal) injustice (properly, the quality, by implication, the act); morally, wrongfulness (of character, life or act)

G94.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1349 (δίκη);
G94.def: unjust; by extension wicked; by implication, treacherous; specially, heathen

G96.derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1384 (δόκιμος);
G96.def: unapproved, i.e. rejected; by implication, worthless (literally or morally)
